Following definitions are used in connection with carrier aggregation (CA):
· PCell (= P-LNCEL = LNCEL in a PCell role): An instance of LNCEL that has one or more instances of MOC CAREL configured.
· SCell (= S-LNCEL = LNCEL in a SCell role): An instance of LNCEL that is referenced by an instance of MOC CAREL, where CAREL-lcrId is the same than LNCEL-lcrId and CAREL-lnBtsId is the same than the LNBTS-lnBtsId of the SCell’s parent LNBTS.
Note: SCells can be located
· in the same LNBTS than the PCell (denoted as "own" SCell/CAREL), if CAREL-lnBtsId is the same than the LNBTS-lnBtsId of the PCell’s parent LNBTS or

relaciones:
(1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) If actETWS is set to 'true', then all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actCMAS must be set to 'false'
- pwsWithEmAreaId is mandatory required
- etwsPrimNotifBcDur is mandatory required.
- In SIB of each cell LNCEL with cellTechnology set to 'FDD' or 'TDD': siWindowLen must be greater than or equal to '20 ms'.
- In SIB of each cell LNCEL with cellTechnology set to 'FDD' or 'TDD': 'SIB10' and 'SIB11' must be present in sibSchedulingList.
- if (actEicic is set to 'true') and (cellType is NOT set to 'large' in any eNB cell) drxProfile5-drxLongCycle must be set to '640' and drxSmartProfile5-drxLongCycle must be set to '640'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) If actETWS is set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to those mentioned in (1.1) for cell instances with cellTechnology set to 'FDD':
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 7 or smaller, then if prsConfigurationIndex is > 150, prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values: '151', '471', '1111' or '2391'.
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND siWindowLen is set to '20 ms' AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 8 or higher then if prsConfigurationIndex is > 150, prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values: '471', '1111' or '2391'.
- if actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND siWindowLen is set to '40 ms' AND the number of configured SIBs (i.e. the number of sets in structure sibSchedulingList + 2) is 8 or higher then if prsConfigurationIndex is > 150, prsConfigurationIndex must be set to one of the following values: '1111' or '2391'.
- For MBMS related dependencies see actMBMS.
(2.3) if (actCMAS or actETWS or sib2xTransmit) is 'true' AND actOtdoa is set to 'true' AND prsConfigurationIndex is set < 151 and dlChBw > '5 MHz', then prsNumDlFrames must be set to 1.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) If actETWS is set to 'true' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to those mentioned in (1.1) for cell instances with cellTechnology set to 'TDD'
- the allowed range of prsConfigurationIndex depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, siWindowLen, sibSchedulingList, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-prsConfigurationIndex for the detailed parameter relationship.
- the allowed range of csiRsSubfrConf depends on sib2xTransmit, actETWS, actCMAS, actOtdoa, tddFrameConf, actEicic, tddSpecSubfConf, cellType and eIcicMaxMutePattern. Please see the parameter LNCEL_TDD-csiRsConfigInfo-csiRsSubfrConf for the detailed parameter relationship.

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

relaciones:
For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.

(1) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD', 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD', then following conditions in (1.x) must be fulfilled:
(1.1) If actDLCAggr is 'true', then actFlexCaMgmt must be configured.
(1.2) If actFlexCaMgmt is 'true', then actDLCAggr must be 'true'.
(1.3) Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' AND actFlexCaMgmt is 'false'.
(1.3.1) - in LNBTS, all instances of LNCEL, where cellTechnology is equal to 'FDD' or 'TDD', must have a value for caPoolId configured.
(1.3.2) - in LNBTS, a maximum of 13 instances of LNCEL can have the same value for caPoolId configured.
(1.3.3) - for each PCell, the PCell and all related own SCells must have the same value for caPoolId configured.
(1.3.4) - for each PCell with cellTechnology equal to 'FDD':
(1.3.4.1) - if additionally actFlexScellSelect is 'false', then for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL/LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(1.3.4.2) - if additionally actFlexScellSelect is 'true', then for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than six different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL/LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(1.3.5) - for each PCell with cellTechnology equal to 'TDD':
(1.3.5.1) - if additionally actFlexScellSelect is 'false', then for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn.
(1.4) Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' AND actFlexCaMgmt is 'true'.
(1.4.1) - for each PCell with cellTechnology equal to 'FDD':
(1.4.1.1) - if additionally actFlexScellSelect is 'false', then for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL/LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(1.4.1.2) - if additionally actFlexScellSelect is 'true', then for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than nine different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL/LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(1.4.2) - for each PCell with cellTechnology equal to 'TDD':
(1.4.2.1) - if additionally actFlexScellSelect is 'false', then for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_TDD-earfcn, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_TDD-earfcn.

(2) If actFlexCaMgmt is 'true', then following condition in (2.1) must be fulfilled:
(2.1) - for each instance of LNCEL, where cellTechnology is 'FDD' or 'TDD', there must be no more than 12 instances of CAREL in all cells in the whole parenting instance of LNBTS, where (CAREL-lnBtsId is equal to LNBTS-lnBtsId) AND (CAREL-lcrId is equal to LNCEL-lcrId).

relaciones:
For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.

(1) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' AND cellTechnology set to 'FDD'
(1.1) – if actFlexScellSelect is set to 'false' then:
(1.1.0) – for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than two different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(1.1.1) – for each PCell there can be a maximum of 1 own CAREL instance, which has an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, i.e., there can be a maximum of 1 own SCell per SCell frequency layer.
(1.1.2) – there can be a maximum of two CAREL instances (own and/or foreign) per PCell.
(1.2) – if actFlexScellSelect is 'true' then
(1.2.1)- if, additionally, actFlexCaMgmt is 'false', then for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than six different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(1.2.2) - if, additionally, actFlexCaMgmt is 'true', then for each PCell, all instances of own CARELs must point to SCells with totally no more than nine different values for LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, which are different from PCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL.
(1.2.3) – for each PCell there can be a maximum of 6 own CAREL instances, which have an identical value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL, i.e., there can be a maximum of 6 own SCell per SCell frequency layer.
(1.2.4) – for each PCell, all own SCells with the same value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL must also have the same value for SCell's LNCEL_FDD-dlChBw.
(1.3) actFlexScellSelect can only be set to 'true' if actDLCAggr is set to 'true.

relaciones:
(1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) actHOtoHrpd can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled in LNBTS:
- actImmHRPD is set to 'true'
- actHOtoWcdma is set to 'false'
- acteNACCtoGSM is set to 'false' 
- actUeBasedAnrUtran is set to 'false'
- actCoC2kWcdmaGsmMob is set to 'false'
(1.2) if actHOtoHrpd is set to 'true' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- eHrpdSectList must be configured in all LNCEL instances
- threshold2C2kConfig must be configured in all LNCEL instances with cellTechnology is 'FDD' or 'TDD'
- hrpdTimers must be configured in all LNCEL instances
- btsSyncMode must be configured to 'PhaseSync'
- hoRegParamHrpd must be configured in all CDFIM instances of LNCEL instances with dlChBw of the related LNCEL_FDD instance equal to or greater than  '5 MHz
- hoRegParamHrpd must not be configured in all CDFIM instances of LNCEL instances with dlChBw of the related LNCEL_FDD instance equal to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) actHOtoHrpd can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled in LNBTS_FDD in addition to (1.1):
- actSrvccToGsm is set to 'false'.
(2.2) if actHOtoHrpd is set to 'true' all of the following conditions are fulfilled in addition to (1.2):
- hoRegParamHrpd must be configured in all CDFIM instances of FDD cells (LNCEL-cellTechnology=’FDD’) whose cell bandwidth in LNCEL_FDD dlChBw is equal to or bigger than '5MHz'

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) actHOtoHrpd can only be configured to 'true' if all of the following conditions are fulfilled in LNBTS_TDD in addition to (1.1):
- actSrvccToGsm is set to 'false' 
- actHOtoTdscdma is set to 'false'.
(3.2) if actHOtoHrpd is set to 'true' all of the following conditions are fulfilled in addition to (1.2):
- hoRegParamHrpd must be configured in all CDFIM instances of TDD cells (LNCEL-cellTechnology=’TDD’).

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).

relaciones:
Definitions used in below parameter relationships:
- PLMN ID: Different PLMN IDs can be configured in moPrMappingList with the combination of the parameters mcc, mnc and mncLength. PLMN ID means the combination of the parameters mcc, mnc and mncLength.
- SPID range: Several spids and SPID ranges can be configured in moPrMappingList with parameters spid and spidLast. SPID range means the range from spid to spidLast. If spidLast is not configured, SPID range means the single spid value.
- EN-DC support: setting of the EN-DC support, where 'all' mean support for 'EN-DC_capable' and 'EN-DC_not_capable'.

If moProfileSelect is set to 'spid', then all the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where moPrId is configured, spid must be configured
- SPID ranges and EN-DC support must be unique with no overlaps in all elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL
- the lteNrDualConnectSupport value must be different per SPID, where
>> for lteNrDualConnectSupport set to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable'.

If moProfileSelect is set to 'plmn', then all the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where moPrId is configured, PLMN ID must be configured
- PLMN ID and EN-DC support must be unique in all elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL
- the lteNrDualConnectSupport value must be different per PLMN ID, where
>> for lteNrDualConnectSupport set to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable'.

If moProfileSelect is set to 'combined', then all the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if configured, the combination of SPID range, PLMN ID and EN-DC support must be unique in all elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL (i.e. SPID range must be unique with no overlaps in all the elements for the same PLMN ID and EN-DC capability).
- the lteNrDualConnectSupport value must be different per SPID -PLMN ID pair, where
  >> for lteNrDualConnectSupport set to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable' for the same SPID-PLMN ID combination.
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where only SPID range is not configured, the combination of PLMN ID and EN-DC support must be unique in all these elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL. EN-DC support is represented by lteNrDualConnectSupport value and if it is set to to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable'.
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where only PLMN ID is not configured, the combination of SPID range and EN-DC support must be unique with no overlaps in all these elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL. EN-DC support is represented by lteNrDualConnectSupport value and if it is set to to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable'.
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where both SPID range and PLMN ID are not configured, the lteNrDualConnectSupport value must be set to either value 'EN-DC_capable' or value 'EN-DC_not_capable'.

relaciones:
Hardware conditions:
(1.1) Small Cells (Flexi Zone Micro, Flexi Zone Controller, Flexi Zone AP, SFN ANT) hardware supports only single technology of cells per eNB, i.e. supported Technology must be configured to 'FDD' OR 'TDD'.

(2.1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_FDD must be configured in the eNB
- all LNCEL instances of the eNB must be configured with cellTechnology value 'FDD' or 'NB-IoT-FDD'.
(2.2) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_TDD must be configured in the eNB
- all LNCEL instances of the eNB must be configured with cellTechnology value 'TDD'.
(2.3) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_FDD AND an instance of LNBTS_TDD must be configured in the eNB.

relaciones:
(1) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to '16QAM', the maximum value for iniMcsDl is 16.
(2) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to 'QPSK', the maximum value for iniMcsDl is 9.
(3)  If actModulationSchemeDl is set to '256QAM' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actDl256QamChQualEst must be configured.
- actExtCellHs must be set to 'false'
(4) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to 'QPSK', '16QAM' or '64QAM', then actDl256QamChQualEst must be either not configured or set to 'false.
(5) if actModulationSchemeDl is configured to 'QPSK', dlInterferenceModulation can only be configured to 'QPSK'.
(6) if actModulationSchemeDl is configured to '16QAM', dlInterferenceModulation can not be configured to '64QAM'.
(7) If actModulationSchemeDl is set to '256QAM', then the maximum value of pMax is equal to:
(MAX(Tx.Carrier.Max.Pa.Power) - Tx.256QAM.Power.Derate) in case of single carrier configuration
(MAX(Tx.Carrier.Max.Pa.Power) - 3 - Tx.256QAM.Power.Derate) in case of dual carrier configuration
If Supports.Additional.Tx.Gain is 'TRUE', and related PASSDEVs are configured, then the related PASSDEV.additionalTxGain and PASSDEV.additionalTxAtenuation should be considered.
Tx.256QAM.Power.Derate, Tx.Carrier.Max.Pa.Power, Supports.Additional.Tx.Gain are BPF TX parameters

Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) Depending on the setting of actModulationSchemeUL the supported range of iniMcsUl is determined:
- if actModulationSchemeUL is set to QPSK, iniMcsUl must be within 0 - 10
- if actModulationSchemeUL is set to 16QAM, iniMcsUl must be within 0 - 20 
- if actModulationSchemeUL is set to 16QAMHighMCS, iniMcsUl must be within 0 - 24
(1.2) if actModulationSchemeUL is set to another value than ('QPSK' or '16QAM')
- actExtCellHs must be configured to 'false'

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) iniMcsUl (ULAMC_INI_MCS) can be located only between MCS0 and MCS20, MCS21 to MCS24 shall not be applicable even if actModulationSchemeUL = "16QAMHighMCS".

(1) The maximum value of dlCellPwrRed_MaxValue is calculated with the following formula:

relaciones:
(1) If cellTechnology is set to 'TDD', nbIoTMode must be set to 'disabled'
(2) If cellTechnology is set to 'FDD', nbIoTMode must not be set to 'standalone'
(3) If cellTechnology is set to 'NB-IoT-FDD', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- nbIoTMode must be set to 'inband' or 'standalone' or ‘guardband’
- NB-IoT cells are not allowed to be included into ULCOMP instance
- if nbIoTMode is set to 'inband' or ‘guardband’, then actFlexDupGap must be set to 'false'
(4) If nbIoTMode is set to 'inband' or 'standalone' or 'guardband', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- csgType must be set to 'OpenAccess'                                              
- actSuperCell must be set to 'false'
- actCombSuperCell must be set to 'false'
(5) If nbIoTMode is set to 'inband', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled in additional to conditions in (4):
- nbIotLinkedCellId must be configured
- inbandPRBIndexDL and inbandPRBIndexUL must be configured in the NBIOT_FDD of the cell instance
- dlChBw must not be set to '1.4MHz' and '3MHz' 
- the values of all parameters in CHANNELGROUP instances belong to the host cell and the inband NB-IoT cell must be same
- MBSFNCEL for this cell instance must not exist
- actLiquidCell must be set to 'false'
- if actCatM is set to 'true', numCELevelCatM must not be set to '3' or '4'
(6) If nbIoTMode is set to 'standalone', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled in additional to conditions in (4):
- standaloneEarfcnDL and standaloneEarfcnUL must be configured in the NBIOT_FDD of the cell instance
- actOtdoa must be set to 'false'.
- MBSFNCEL for this cell instance must not exist
- actEicic must be set to 'false'
- actLiquidCell must be set to 'false'
(7) If nbIoTMode is set to 'guardband', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled in additional to conditions in (4):
- nbIotLinkedCellId must be configured
- guardbandIndexDL and guardbandIndexUL must be configured in the NBIOT_FDD of the cell instance
- dlChBw must be set to '10MHz' or ’15MHz’ or ’20MHz’ in LNCEL_FDD with cellTechnology is 'FDD'
- the values of all parameters in CHANNELGROUP instances belong to the host cell and the guardband NB-IoT cell must be same
- actRedFreqOffset must be set to 'false'
- actDlSlimCarrier must be set to 'false'
- the referenced RF module is 'guardband' capable

(1.4) If Supports.Additional.Tx.Gain is 'TRUE', and related PASSDEVs are configured, then consider related PASSDEV.additionalTxGain and PASSDEV.additionalTxAttenuation of pMax, the result must not exceed the RF unit capability.

- parameter c2KTimers must be configured
- parameter rttCellIdInfo must be configured.

(1.3) If (act1xCsfb is set to 'true') AND (actCoC2kWcdmaGsmMob is set to "true") then for all LNCEL instances rttCsfbType shall not be set to 'R9e1xCsfb'
(1.4) If act1xCsfb is equal to 'true' and btsSyncMode is not equal to 'PhaseSync' then for all LNCEL instances: rttCsfbType shall not be set to 'R9e1xCsfb'.

note1:

LTE3145 enabled = actDlSlimCarrier is set to "true" and ( numBlankDlPrbsUp+ numBlankDlPrbsDown >0 )"

rango:

relacionados:

relaciones:
Conditions in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) If ulChBw is set to '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz', ulsSchedMethod must be configured to 'channel unaware'.
(1.2) If ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel aware' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.2.1) when in addition actPuschMask is set to 'false', srsActivation must be set to 'true' and srsPwrOffset must be configured
(1.2.2) when in addition actPuschMask is set to 'true', srsActivation must be set to 'false'
(1.3) If ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel aware') all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- ulsFdPrbAssignAlg must be configured to 'Mixed FD'
- tPeriodicPhr is not allowed to be configured to 'infinity'
(1.4) If ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel unaware') all of the following condition must be fulfilled:
(1.4.1) when in addition actUlLnkAdp is not set to 'fUlLa': srsActivation must be set to 'false' 
(1.4.2) when in addition actUlLnkAdp is set to 'fUlLa' AND srsActivation is set to 'true': srsPwrOffset must be configured.
(1.5) if ulsSchedMethod is set to ('interference aware' or 'channel aware') then ulsNumSchedAreaUl must be present and configured.
(1.6) If actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none', ulsSchedMethod must be set to any of 'channel aware' or 'interference aware'.
(1.7) If actPuschPrbDistribution is set to 'true', ulsSchedMethod must be set to any of 'channel aware' or 'interference aware'.

Conditions in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) ulsSchedMethod must be configured to 'channel unaware' OR 'channel aware'
(2.2) If ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel aware' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- ulsFdPrbAssignAlg must be configured to 'Mixed FD'
- tPeriodicPhr is not allowed to be configured to 'infinity'
- srsActivation must be configured to 'true'
- srsPwrOffset must be configured.
(2.3) If ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel unaware' following condition need to be fulfilled:
- when in addition actUlLnkAdp is set to 'fUlLa' AND srsActivation is set to 'true': srsPwrOffset must be configured.
(2.4) If ulsSchedMethod is set to 'channel aware', then ulsNumSchedAreaUl must be present and configured.
(2.5) If LNCEL_TDD-actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none', ulsSchedMethod must be set to any of 'channel aware' or 'interference aware'.
(2.6) If actPuschPrbDistribution is set to 'true', then ulsSchedMethod must be set to any of 'channel aware' or 'interference aware'.

If ttiBundlingBlerThreshold is configured, it must be greater than ulTargetBler.
The following condition must be fulfilled: qci1BlerTgtConfig.qci1UlBlerTarget less than or equal to ulTargetBler.

numBlankDlPrbsDown must be configured if actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true'.

if actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' then numBlankDlPrbsUp + numBlankDlPrbsDown must be <=  40% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell. 
40% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 6 if dlChBw is equal to '3 MHz'
- 10 if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'
- 20 if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz'
- 30 if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz'
- 40 if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz'

If actDlSlimCarrier is set to ‘true’ and actDynamicSharedSpectrum is set to ´true´ then numBlankDlPrbsDown must be <= 20% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell.
20% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 3 if dlChBw is equal to ‘3MHz’
- 5 if dlChBw is equal to ‘5MHz’
- 10 if dlChBw is equal to ‘10 MHz’
- 15 if dlChBw is equal to ’15 MHz’
- 20 if dlChBw is equal to ’20 MHz’

If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true and nbIotMode is set to 'inband' in the superior LNCEL instance then the following condition must be additionally fulfilled in the related NB IoT inband LNCEL instance, i.e. the LNCEL instance with lcrId equal to nbIotLinkedCellId of hosting wideband LNCEL instance:
 - inbandPRBIndexDL must be greater than or equal to numBlankDlPrbsDown

If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' then the range for numBlankDlPrbsDown shall be as follows:
- 0..4 if dlChBw is equal to '3 MHz'
- 0..9 if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'.

numBlankDlPrbsUp must be configured if actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true'.

if actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' then numBlankDlPrbsUp + numBlankDlPrbsDown must be smaller than or equal to 40% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell. 
40% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 6 if dlChBw is equal to '3 MHz'
- 10 if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'
- 20 if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz'
- 30 if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz'
- 40 if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz'

If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' and actDynamicSharedSpectrum is set to 'true' then numBlankDlPrbsUp must be smaller than or equal to 20% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell.
20% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 3 if dlChBw is equal to '3MHz'
- 5 if dlChBw is equal to '5MHz'
- 10 if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz'
- 15 if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz'
- 20 if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz'

If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' on an LNCEL_FDD and an NBIOT_FDD instance exists subordinate the same LNCEL instance and nbIotMode is set to 'inband', the following condition must be additionally fulfilled:
 - inbandPRBIndexDL + numBlankDlPrbsUp must be smaller than max number of downlink PRBs of the cell.
max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 25 if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'
- 50 if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz'
- 75 if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz'
- 100 if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz'

If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' then the range for numBlankDlPrbsUp shall be as follows:
- 0..4 if dlChBw is equal to '3 MHz'
- 0..9 if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'.

The configuration of structure csfbRegParam1xRtt depends among others on the slim carrier configuration (note1)(for details please refer to the definition in csfbRegParam1xRtt ).

All of the following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.

(1) The maximum value of nCqiRb depends on ulChBw (in PRB)
- if ulChBw is set to '1.4 MHz', nCqiRb must be configured to 1 
- if ulChBw is set to '3 MHz', nCqiRb must be configured to 1
- if ulChBw is set to '5 MHz', nCqiRb is restricted to 1..25
- if ulChBw is set to '10 MHz', nCqiRb is restricted to 1..50
- if ulChBw is set to '15 MHz', nCqiRb is restricted to 1..75
- if ulChBw is set to '20 MHz', nCqiRb is not limited

(2) The value of blankedPucch must be less than nCqiRb.

Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' in the parent LNBTS of the PCell.
(3.1) nCqiRb is considered in calculation of maxNumRrc in PCell, for details please refer to maxNumRrc
(3.2) nCqiRb is considered in calculation of maxNumRrcEmergency in PCell, for details please refer to maxNumRrcEmergency

(4) The MaxPucchResourceSize in below defines the maximum number of allocated PUCCH RBs, and it can be calculated with following formula and used finally in prachFreqOff:
MaxPucchResourceSize = nCqiRb + roundup{[((rounddown (((maxNrSymPdcch * 12 - X) * dlChBw - roundup (phichRes * (dlChBw / 8)) *  12 - 16) / 36)) + n1PucchAn - pucchNAnCs * 3 / deltaPucchShift ) * deltaPucchShift] / (3*12)} + roundup (pucchNAnCs / 8) - blankedPucch,

where 
X=4; when maxNrSymPdcch = 1 or dlMimoMode set to 'SingleTX', 'TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop Mimo'
X=8 when maxNrSymPdcch > 1 and dlMimoMode set to '4-way TXDiv' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)'

(5)
If ulChBw is '20 MHz'  or '15 MHz', MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 24PRB,
If ulChBw is '10 MHz : MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 24PRB,
If ulChBw is '5 MHz' : MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 24PRB,
If ulChBw is '3 MHz': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 2 PRB
If ulChBw is '1.4 MHz': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 2 PRB

(6)
For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Following conditions need to be fulfilled in the MPUCCH instance if a cell is configured as a PCell:
Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' in the parent LNBTS of the PCell.
(6.1a) - If maxNumScells is greater than '1', then nPucchF3Prb must be greater than '0'.
(6.1b) - If maxNumScells is smaller than or equal to '1', then nPucchF3Prb must be '0'.
(6.2) - nCqiRb must be greater than blankedPucch (see also above at (2))

(7.1) For ulChBw of '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' and '20 MHz': 
if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'None' or blankedPucch is less than '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff range is:
roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2) … ulChBw (in PRBs) - 6 - roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2)

(7.2) For ulChBw of '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' and '20 MHz':
- if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'LowerEdge' and blankedPucch is greater than or equal to '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff ranges are:
+ (0 ... roundup (blankedPucch/2) - 6) and
+ (roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2) … ulChBw (in PRBs) - 6 - roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2))
- if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'UpperEdge' and blankedPucch is greater than or equal to '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff ranges are:
+ (roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2) … ulChBw (in PRBs) - 6 - roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2)) and
+ ((ulChBw(in PRBs) – roundup (blankedPuccch/2)) ... ulChBw(in PRBs) – 6)

Note: MaxPucchResourceSize is calculated in nCqiRb.

3) operatingMode must be set to 'Normal'.
4) actLocationLock must be "true"

8) The desiredPmax/desiredPmax20M/desiredPmax10M value depends on the radio module and maxGrantPwrRed. During online commissioning the EM will based on the hardware variant support only the allowed values. Please refer to the BPF where per variant the supported power values are specified.

10) The allowed (desiredPmax/desiredPmax20M/desiredPmax10M - maxGrantPwrRed) value must not be lower than the min Tx power value defined for that HW variant.
11) If CBRS.Supported=true, either actCbrs or actPart90Z must be set to true.
12) If LNCEL_TDD-actUlPwrRestrScn is not set to 'none', actCbrs must be set to 'true'.

- actIMSEmerSessR9, actSrvccToWcdma, actSrvccToGsm and act1xSrvcc are all set to 'false'.

LTE1800 is deactivated (actDlIntShaping is configured to ‘false’)

LTE1169 is deactivated (actDlMuMimo is set to 'false') for each cell in the csBIACellList

relaciones:
(1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) actMultBearers can only be set to 'false' if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false'.
(1.1.1) Only if actMultBearers is set to 'true', actEnhAcAndGbrServices can be set to 'true'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(2.1) If actMultBearers is set to 'false', actConvVoice in LNBTS_FDD must be set to 'false'.
All of the following conditions in (2.2.x) are applicable in MPUCCH_FDD of the FDD-cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'
(2.2) If actMultBearers is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled for maxNumRrc:
- min(6*(maxNumRrc+ max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)), 4500) >= maxNumActDrb + max(addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(2.2.1) if in addition actIMSEmerSessR9 is set to 'true' for maxNumRrcEmergency AND if no AirScale deployment (BPF property HW.Release < 4), following condition must be fulfilled:
if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' 
- min(6*maxNumRrcEmergency, 4500) >= maxNumActDrb + max(4*addEmergencySessions, addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(2.2.1.1) if in addition actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' for maxNumRrcEmergency following condition must be fulfilled:
- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumQci1Drb + max(addEmergencySessions, addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo)

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
(3.1) If actMultBearers is set to 'false' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actConvVoice in LNBTS_TDD must be configured to 'false'
- actVoLteCallSteering in LNBTS_TDD must be configured to 'false'.
All of the following conditions in (3.2.x) are applicable in MPUCCH_TDD of the TDD-cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'
(3.2) If actMultBearers is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled for maxNumRrc:
- min(6*(maxNumRrc+ max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)), 4200) >= maxNumActDrb + max(addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(3.2.1) if in addition actIMSEmerSessR9 is set to 'true' for maxNumRrcEmergency AND if no AirScale deployment (BPF property HW.Release < 4), following condition must be fulfilled:
if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' 
- min(6*maxNumRrcEmergency, 4500) >= maxNumActDrb + max(4*addEmergencySessions, addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(3.2.1.1) if in addition actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' for maxNumRrcEmergency following condition must be fulfilled:
- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumQci1Drb + max(addEmergencySessions, addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo)

(4) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (2) AND (3) must be fulfilled in addition to (1).
actMultGbrBearers can only be set to 'true' if actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'true'.

relaciones:
(1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' or 'TDD' or 'mixed_FDD_TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) LCELL-CHANNELGROUP-CHANNEL configuration:
In the following conditions:
- cells having LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL configured in an unlicensed band, or
- cells assigned to ASIRMODs
- cells having LNCEL-cellTechnology configured to ‘NB-IoT-FDD’ and LNCEL-nbIoTMode configured to either ‘inband’ or ‘guardband’
are excluded.
(1.1.1) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is 'false' just a single LCELL can be assigned per antenna line, i.e. there cannot be several LCELLs having identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.2) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '2_carrierOperation' up to two LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.3) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '3_carrierOperation' up to three LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.4) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '4_carrierOperation' up to four LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.5) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '5_carrierOperation' up to five LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.
(1.1.6) If actMultipleCarrier parameter value is '6_carrierOperation' up to six LCELL can share the same antenna line, i.e. have identical configuration in parameter CHANNEL-antlDN with parameter CHANNEL-direction set to 'TX'.

(2) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' following conditions must be fulfilled in addition to (1):
In the following conditions cells assigned to ASIRMODs are excluded.
(2.1) actMultipleCarrier can just be configured to value 'false', '2_carrierOperation' or '3_carrierOperation' or '4_carrierOperation'.
(2.2) If actMultipleCarrier is not set to 'false', all carrier sharing the same antenna for transmission must have configured same tddFrameConf and tddSpecSubfConf in cells with cellTechnology set to 'TDD'.

(3) If the supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' conditions of (1) AND (2) must be fulfilled.

LNCEL - moPrMappingList-spidLast
relaciones:
Definitions used in below parameter relationships:
- PLMN ID: Different PLMN IDs can be configured in moPrMappingList with the combination of the parameters mcc, mnc and mncLength. PLMN ID means the combination of the parameters mcc, mnc and mncLength.
- SPID range: Several spids and SPID ranges can be configured in moPrMappingList with parameters spid and spidLast. SPID range means the range from spid to spidLast. If spidLast is not configured, SPID range means the single spid value.
- EN-DC support: setting of the EN-DC support, where 'all' mean support for 'EN-DC_capable' and 'EN-DC_not_capable'.

If moProfileSelect is set to 'spid', then all the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where moPrId is configured, spid must be configured
- SPID ranges and EN-DC support must be unique with no overlaps in all elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL
- the lteNrDualConnectSupport value must be different per SPID, where
>> for lteNrDualConnectSupport set to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable'.

If moProfileSelect is set to 'plmn', then all the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where moPrId is configured, PLMN ID must be configured
- PLMN ID and EN-DC support must be unique in all elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL
- the lteNrDualConnectSupport value must be different per PLMN ID, where
>> for lteNrDualConnectSupport set to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable'.

If moProfileSelect is set to 'combined', then all the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if configured, the combination of SPID range, PLMN ID and EN-DC support must be unique in all elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL (i.e. SPID range must be unique with no overlaps in all the elements for the same PLMN ID and EN-DC capability).
- the lteNrDualConnectSupport value must be different per SPID -PLMN ID pair, where
  >> for lteNrDualConnectSupport set to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable' for the same SPID-PLMN ID combination.
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where only SPID range is not configured, the combination of PLMN ID and EN-DC support must be unique in all these elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL. EN-DC support is represented by lteNrDualConnectSupport value and if it is set to to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable'.
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where only PLMN ID is not configured, the combination of SPID range and EN-DC support must be unique with no overlaps in all these elements of moPrMappingList within LNCEL. EN-DC support is represented by lteNrDualConnectSupport value and if it is set to to 'all' no other entry is allowed with value 'EN-DC_capable' or 'EN-DC_not_capable'.
- in the elements of moPrMappingList where both SPID range and PLMN ID are not configured, the lteNrDualConnectSupport value must be set to either value 'EN-DC_capable' or value 'EN-DC_not_capable'.

Hardware conditions:

- WNBTS
- GNBTS
- LNBTS_FDD

(2.1) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'FDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_FDD must be configured in the eNB
- all LNCEL instances of the eNB must be configured with cellTechnology value 'FDD' or 'NB-IoT-FDD'
(2.2) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'TDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_TDD must be configured in the eNB
- all LNCEL instances of the eNB must be configured with cellTechnology value 'TDD'.
(2.3) If supportedCellTechnology is configured to 'mixed_FDD_TDD' all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- an instance of LNBTS_FDD AND an instance of LNBTS_TDD must be configured in the eNB.

relaciones:
If emerHoBlockPlmnAcbMax is set to ‘TRUE’ then cellResHoBlockPlmnAcbMax from the same ACBPR must be set to ‘reserved’
Additionally if emerHoBlockPlmnAcbMax is set to 'TRUE' it must be ensured that emergency call handling is activated in the eNB. This means that depending on the cellTechnology of LNCEL instances referencing the profile at least one of the following parameters must be set to 'TRUE'. The following checks are not relevant if the profile is not yet referenced by any LNCEL instance.

If cellResHoBlockPlmnAcbMax is set to 'reserved' and if cellTechnology of all LNCEL instances referring to the ACBPR instance is 'FDD' then at least one of the following parameters must be set to 'TRUE': act1xCsfb, actDualRx1xCsfb, actCsfbPsHoToUtra, actEmerCallRedir or LNBTS_FDD-actIMSEmerSessR9.

If cellResHoBlockPlmnAcbMax is set to 'reserved' and if cellTechnology of all LNCEL instances referring to the ACBPR instance is 'TDD' then at least one of the following parameters must be set to 'TRUE': act1xCsfb, actDualRx1xCsfb, actCsfbPsHoToUtra, actEmerCallRedir or LNBTS_TDD-actIMSEmerSessR9.

Otherwise at least one of the following parameters must be set to 'TRUE' if cellResHoBlockPlmnAcbMax is set to 'reserved' :
act1xCsfb, actDualRx1xCsfb, actCsfbPsHoToUtra, actEmerCallRedir or (LNBTS_FDD-actIMSEmerSessR9 and LNBTS_TDD-actIMSEmerSessR9).

If acbPrimaryPlmnProfileIdCatM is configured and referenced ACBPR instance must exist, all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:

If actUnlicensedDfs is 'true', then all following conditions must be fulfilled:

- sFreqPrioDfs must be configured.
- antennaGain must be configured.
- ccaAvgFailureRateOffsetDfs must be configured.

- in all instances of LNUPR, uCellChannelSList bits 5, 14 and 15 must be set to '0'.
- if additionally, lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI', then all channels in the following bit ranges must be disabled for uCellChannelSList: {0..14}, {21..23}
- if additionally, lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI' AND one instance of LNCEL in the unlicensed band is configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least one bit set to '1' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}
- if additionally, lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI' AND two instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least two bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
- if additionally, lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI' AND three instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least three bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
- if additionally, lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI' AND If four instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId) then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least four bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
- if additionally, lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI', then the sum over pMax of all unlicensed cells as defined in parameters actUnlicensedAcc and actUnlicensedDfs linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId) must be smaller than or equal to [27.03 - antennaGain] [dBm]: Note: summing has to be done in linear scale

If actUnlicensedDfs is 'false', then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
- uCellChannelSList bits {10...27} must be '0'.
- if, additionally, lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI' and there are four unclicensed cells configured as defined in parameters actUnlicensedAcc and actUnlicensedDfs linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the sum over Pmax over all that cells must be smaller than or equal to [26.03 - max(0, antennaGain - 6)] [dBm]: Note: summing has to be done in linear scale.

relaciones:
If actUnlicensedAcc is 'LAA' then antennaGain must be configured.

If actUnlicensedDfs is 'true', then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
- antennaGain must be configured.

If, additionally, lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI', then the sum over pMax of all unlicensed cells as defined in parameters actUnlicensedAcc and actUnlicensedDfs linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId) must be smaller than or equal to [27.03 - antennaGain] [dBm]: Note: summing has to be done in linear scale

If actUnlicensedDfs is 'false' AND lteUItuRegion is set to 'USA', then the sum over pMax of all unlicensed cells as defined in parameters actUnlicensedAcc and actUnlicensedDfs linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId) must be smaller than or equal to [27.03 - max(0, antennaGain - 6 dB)] [dBm]: Note: summing has to be done in linear scale.

If actUnlicensedDfs is 'false' AND there are four unlicensed cells configured as defined in parameters actUnlicensedAcc and actUnlicensedDfs linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the sum over pMax over all that cells must be smaller than or equal to [26.03 - max(0, antennaGain - 6)] [dBm]: Note: summing has to be done in linear scale.

relaciones:
(1) If actUnlicensedDcs is equal to 'true', then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1.1) uCellChannelSList must be configured.
(1.2) Bit 5 of uCellChannelSList must be '0'. (Note: use of channel 32 is currently not supported).
(1.3) For each instance of LNUPR:
 If N is the maximum number of instances of LNCEL_FDD
 - with LNCEL_FDD-earfcnDL from an unlicensed band, as defined in parameter LNBTS_FDD-actUnlicensedAcc, and
 - with LNCEL_FDD-lnuprId equal to LNUPR-lnuprId, and 
 - with the LNCEL_FDD instances linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId),
 then in uCellChannelSList of this instance of LNUPR there shall be at least N WiFi channels activated (N bits equal to â€1â€™) within a range corresponding to 62 MHz.

(1.4) If lteUItuRegion is set to 'USA':
(1.4.1) If two instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least two bits set to '1' that are separated by no more than two bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {0..4} or {5...9}.
(1.4.2) If three instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least three bits set to '1' that are separated by no more than one bit set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {0..4} or {5...9}.
(1.4.3) If four instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId) then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least four bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {0..4} or {5...9}.

(1.5) If lteUItuRegion is set to 'ETSI':
(1.5.1) all channels in the following bit ranges must be disabled: {0..14}, {21..23}
(1.5.2) if one instance of LNCEL in the unlicensed band is configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least one bit set to '1' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
(1.5.3) if two instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least two bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
(1.5.4) if three instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId), then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least three bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.
(1.5.5) If four instances of LNCEL in the unlicensed band are configured and linked to the same instance of RMOD (via rModId) then the corresponding uCellChannelSList must contain at least four bits set to '1' that are separated by no bits set to '0' in at least one of the bit ranges {16..20} or {24..27}.

(2) If actUnlicensedDfs is 'true' then all following conditions must be fulfilled:
(2.1) In all instances of LNUPR, uCellChannelSList bits 5, 14 and 15 must be set to '0'.
(3) If actUnlicensedDfs is 'false', then uCellChannelSList bits {10...27} must be '0'.

(4) If actUnlicensedAcc is 'LAA', then following condition has to be fullfilled:
(4.1) for N configured unlicensed cells, then the uCellChannelSList must contain at least N bits set to '1'

The parameter actConvVoice can only be set to 'true' if actMultBearers is set to 'true', i.e. if actMultBearers is set to 'false', actConvVoice must be 'false'.

The parameter actConvVoice can only be set to 'false' if 
- qciTab5-schedulType is set to 'NON-GBR' AND
- actIMSEmerSessR9, actSrvccToWcdma, actSrvccToGsm and act1xSrvcc are all set to 'false'.

Only if actConvVoice is set to 'true' the following conditions are applicable
- actInterFreqServiceBasedHo is allowed to be configured to 'true'
- actDedVoLteInterFreqHo is allowed to be configured to 'true'
- actQci1eVTT is allowed to be configured to 'true'
- actVoipCovBoost is allowed to be configured to 'true'

- n310Qci1 is allowed to be configured
- actVoLteSrcRate is allowed to be configured to 'true' in cells with cellTechnology set to 'TDD'
- actQci1BlerTgt is allowed to be configured to 'true'

If actConvVoice is set to 'true', then harqMaxTrVoLteDl must be configured in cells with cellTechnology set to 'TDD'.

actIMSEmerSessFWAUEs must be set to 'false', if actConvVoice is set to 'false'

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.
Following conditions need to be fulfilled, if a cell is configured as a PCell:
- If actDLCAggr is 'true' AND actConvVoice is 'true in the parent LNBTS, then dlCaMinPcellCqiQci1 must be configured.
- If actDLCAggr is 'true' AND actConvVoice is 'true in the parent LNBTS, then ulCaMinPcellSinrQci1 must be configured.

relaciones:
Definition in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) If actCombSupercell is set to 'false', the maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
- with 
           If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
           If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

(1.2) If actCombSupercell is set to 'true', the maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((LNCEL_FDD-subCellConf-pMaxSubCell [dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue shall be calculated for all configured subcells with above formula and the lowest calculated dlCellPwrRedMaxValue shall be used for the following dependency: 
- with 
           If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
           If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

Note:
- 10*log10(1/6) is considering of the worst case of no DL traffic, there is only common CRS
- 10*log10(4/14) is considering of in the worst case no DL traffic, only 4 OFDMA symbols get DL singnal
- RfmMinOutputPwr is the minimum output power of the related radio module in dBm. Below this power the signal is considered abnormally low for the radio module.

Definition in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) The maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
(2.1.1) without 8 pipe beamforming, i.e. if the related LCELL contains less than eight CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX':
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
- with
           If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
           If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

Note:
- 10*log10(1/6) is considering of the worst case of no DL traffic, there is only common CRS
- 10*log10(4/14) is considering of in the worst case no DL traffic, only 4 OFDMA symbols get DL singnal
- RfmMinOutputPwr is the minimum output power of the related radio module in dBm. Below this power the signal is considered abnormally low for the radio module.

(2.1.2) for 8 pipe beamforming, i.e. if the related LCELL contains eight CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX', and those CHANNEL instances refer antenna lines (parameter antlDN in the same CHANNEL instance), which are contained in one radio module (RMOD MO):
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] -3 + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
Note: '-3' here is for calibration power reduce

relaciones:
Definition in (1.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'FDD':
(1.1) If actCombSupercell is set to 'false', the maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
- with 

         If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
         If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

(1.2) If actCombSupercell is set to 'true', the maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((LNCEL_FDD-subCellConf-pMaxSubCell [dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue shall be calculated for all configured subcells with above formula and the lowest calculated dlCellPwrRedMaxValue shall be used for the following dependency: 
- with 

         If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
         If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

Note:
- 10*log10(1/6) is considering of the worst case of no DL traffic, there is only common CRS
- 10*log10(4/14) is considering of in the worst case no DL traffic, only 4 OFDMA symbols get DL singnal
- RfmMinOutputPwr is the minimum output power of the related radio module in dBm. Below this power the signal is considered abnormally low for the radio module.

Definition in (2.x) are valid if the cellTechnology of the LNCEL instance is configured to 'TDD':
(2.1) The maximum value of dlCellPwrRedMaxValue is calculated with the following formula:
(2.1.1) without 8 pipe beamforming, i.e. if the related LCELL contains less than eight CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX':
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
- with
           If actMBMS = false, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue
           If actMBMS = true, 0 <= dlCellPwrRed + cellPwrRedForMBMS <= dlCellPwrRedMaxValue

Note:
- 10*log10(1/6) is considering of the worst case of no DL traffic, there is only common CRS
- 10*log10(4/14) is considering of in the worst case no DL traffic, only 4 OFDMA symbols get DL singnal
- RfmMinOutputPwr is the minimum output power of the related radio module in dBm. Below this power the signal is considered abnormally low for the radio module.

(2.1.2) With 8 pipe beamforming, i.e. if the related LCELL contains eight CHANNEL instances with parameter direction set to 'TX', and those CHANNEL instances refer antenna lines (parameter antlDN in the same CHANNEL instance), which are contained in one radio module (RMOD MO):
dlCellPwrRedMaxValue [dB] = max((pMax[dBm] - RfmMinOutputPwr[dBm] -3 + 10 * log10(1/6) + 10*log10(4/14)), 0)
Note: '-3' here is for calibration power reduce
(2.3) dlCellPwrRed range is limited to maximal 10 dB

(1.6) - if maximum(maxNumScells) in all PCells, where cellTechnology is 'FDD', …
(1.6.1) … is equal to '1', then maxNumMimoLayerFdd must be configured to '10'.
(1.6.2) … is equal to' 2', then maxNumMimoLayerFdd must be configured to '10' or '12'.
(1.6.3) … is equal to '3', then maxNumMimoLayerFdd must be configured to '10', '12', '14' or '16'.

relaciones:
(1) If cellTechnology is set to 'TDD', nbIoTMode must be set to 'disabled'
(2) If cellTechnology is set to 'FDD', nbIoTMode must not be set to 'standalone'
(3) If cellTechnology is set to 'NB-IoT-FDD',  all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- nbIoTMode must be set to 'inband' or 'standalone' or 'guardband'
- NB-IoT cells are not allowed to be included into ULCOMP instance
- if nbIoTMode is set to 'inband' or 'guardband', then actFlexDupGap must be set to 'false'
(4) If nbIoTMode is set to 'inband' or 'standalone' or 'guardband', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- actMicroDtx must be set to 'false'
- csgType must be set to 'OpenAccess'                                              
- actCombSuperCell must be set to 'false' 
- in same LNCEL instance lteNrDssMode must be set to 'none' or actLteNrDss must be set to 'false'
(5) If nbIoTMode is set to 'inband', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled in addition to conditions in (4):
- nbIotLinkedCellId must be configured
- inbandPRBIndexDL and inbandPRBIndexUL must be configured in the NBIOT_FDD of the cell instance
- dlChBw must not be set to '1.4MHz' or '3MHz' 
- dlChBw must not be set to '5MHz' if parameter actDynamicSharedSpectrum is set to true under corresponding LCELL object (LCELL which id is equal to lcrId of LNCEL in the linked host LTE cell)
- the values of all parameters in CHANNELGROUP instances of the host cell and the inband NB-IoT cell must be same
- the values of all parameters in BBPOOLALLOC instances of the host cell and the inband NB-IoT cell must be same
- MBSFNCEL for this cell instance must not exist
- actLiquidCell must be set to 'false'
- if actCatM is set to 'true', numCELevelCatM must not be set to '3' or '4'
- actExtendedNPRACH must be 'false'
- actDownSampling must be set as same value as its host LTE cell (cellTechnology is 'FDD').
(6) If nbIoTMode is set to 'standalone', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled in addition to conditions in (4):
- standaloneEarfcnDL and standaloneEarfcnUL must be configured in the NBIOT_FDD of the cell instance
- actOtdoa must be set to 'false'
- MBSFNCEL for this cell instance must not exist
- actEicic must be set to 'false'
- actLiquidCell must be set to 'false'
- actCoMp can not be configured to 'measBasedCoMp' if the cell is included in COMPCONF-measBasedCellConf-lnCelId
- actMMimo in same LNCEL_FDD instance is 'false'
- actDownSampling is not allowed to be configured to 'true'.
(7) If nbIoTMode is set to 'guardband', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled in addition to conditions in (4):
- nbIotLinkedCellId must be configured
- guardbandIndexDL and guardbandIndexUL must be configured in the NBIOT_FDD of the cell instance
- dlChBw must be set to '10MHz' or '15MHz' or '20MHz' in LNCEL_FDD with cellTechnology is 'FDD'
- the values of all parameters in CHANNELGROUP instances of the host cell and the guardband NB-IoT cell must be same
- the values of all parameters in BBPOOLALLOC instances of the host cell and the guardband NB-IoT cell must be same 
- actRedFreqOffset must be set to 'false'
- actDlSlimCarrier must be set to 'false'
- the referenced RF module is 'guardband' capable
- actExtendedNPRACH must be 'false'
- actDownSampling must be set to as same value as its host LTE cell (cellTechnology is 'FDD').
(8) If LNCEL_FDD.actMMimo is 'true' and LNCEL.nbIoTMode is set to 'inband' for a cell then in linked NB-IoT cell (indicated by LNCEL.nbIoTLinkedCellId) numDlNonAnchCarrierNB must be set to '0'.

(1.6.1) uMbsfnShareMax is less than or equal to 30%, then raRespWinSize must be greater than or equal '6'.

- AirScale HW: actCombSuperCell must be 'false' for all LNCEL_FDD instances belonging to an ulCoMpCellList.

If actCombSuperCell is set to 'true' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled: 
- dlMimoMode must be set to one of the values: 'SingleTX', 'TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop Mimo'.
- For FSMr3: the related LCELL must contain at least 2 CHANNELGROUP instances (subcells), and may contain up to 3 CHANNELGROUP instances (subcells)

>> if dlMimoMode is set to 'TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop Mimo' then 4 CHANNEL instances must be contained and each of two of the CHANNEL instances must have identical configuration for parameter antlDN, and must have different configuration for parameter direction
>> if dlMimoMode is set to 'SingleTX' then 3 CHANNEL instances must be contained where two of the CHANNEL instances must have identical configuration for parameter antlDN, and must have different configuration for parameter direction (i.e. in one of these CHANNEL instances direction must be set to 'TX' and in the other CHANNEL instance direction must be set to 'RX') and in the third CHANNEL instance direction must be set to 'RX' and antlDN must be different from the antlDN configured in the other two CHANNEL instances.
- dlChBw must be set to value '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' or '20 MHz'.
- enhCellVendorSpecTracing-ripTracing must be configured to 'false' in all MTRACE instances belonging to the LNCEL/LNCEL_FDD.
- ripAlarmingConfig-actRIPAlarming must be configured to 'false' in same LNCEL_FDD instance.
- actSuperCell and actLiquidCell must be configured to 'false'.
- subCellConf must be configured.

- actUlPwrRestrScn must be set to 'none'
- actMMimo in same LNCEL_FDD instance is 'false'
- in same LNCEL instance lteNrDssMode must be set to 'none' or actLteNrDss must be set to 'false'

If actCombSuperCell is set to 'false', all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- subCellConf shall not be configured
- if (actSuperCell is set to 'false' AND actLiquidCell is set to 'false') then there must be just 1 CHANNELGROUP instance contained in the related LCELL object.

(1) actDlSlimCarrier can be set to 'true' only if all following conditions are fulfilled:
- dlsDciCch is set to 'DCI format 1A'
- dlChBw is not equal to '1.4 MHz'
- no MBSFNCEL instance is created in the related LNCEL instance
- actDlIsh is set to 'false' and amountBlankedRes is equal to '0'
- actCatM is set to 'false'
- dlInterferenceEnable is set to 'false'
- numBlankDlPrbsDown and numBlankDlPrbsUp must be configured

- nbIoTMode is not set to 'guardband'
- in same LNCEL instance lteNrDssMode is set to 'none' or actLteNrDss is set to 'false'
- prsBandwidth shall have a value less than or equal (DL PRBs - 2*max(numBlankDLPrbsDown,numBlankDLPrbsUp)), where DL PRBs depends on the configured DL channel bandwidth (dlChBw) as follows:
- for dlChBw set to '3MHz', DL PRBs is equal to 15 PRBs
- for dlChBw set to '5MHz', DL PRBs is equal to 25 PRBs
- for dlChBw set to '10MHz', DL PRBs is equal to 50 PRBs
- for dlChBw set to '15MHz', DL PRBs is equal to 75 PRBs
- for dlChBw set to '20MHz', DL PRBs is equal to 100 PRBs.

(2) If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' and nbIotMode is set to 'inband' in the superior LNCEL instance then the following conditions must be additionally fulfilled in the related NB IoT inband LNCEL instance, i.e. the LNCEL instance with lcrId equal to nbIotLinkedCellId of hosting wideband LNCEL instance:
- inbandPRBIndexDL must be greater than or equal to numBlankDlPrbsDown
- inbandPRBIndexDL + numBlankDlPrbsUp must be less than max number of downlink PRBs of the cell.

(3) If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'false' then:
- slimRfFilterDL must be set 'nominal'
- slimRfFilterUL must be set 'nominal'

(4) If actDlSlimCarrier is set to 'true' and if actRedFreqOffset is set to 'true' then
- actDynamicSharedSpectrum must be set to 'true' in the corresponding LCELL object (same IcrId as the superior LNCEL of this LNCEL_FDD)
- slimRfFilterDL must be set to 'nominal'
- slimRfFilterUL must set to 'nominal'

(5) The number of IRFIM instances and the number of list items in intFrBCList and intFrNCList  depend among others on the slim carrier configuration (for details please refer to the definition in intFrNCList and intFrBCList).

(6) actDlSlimCarrier is not allowed to set to 'true' in LNCEL_FDD instance which is subordinate to the LNCEL instance with lcrId equal to nbIotLinkedCellId of the superior LNCEL instance if numDlNonAnchCarrierNB value is not 0 and one of following conditions is fulfilled:
- (inbandPRBIndexDL mod RBGsize) = 0 and inbandPRBIndexDL + numBlankDlPrbsUp >= dlChBw(in PRBs) - 1;
- (inbandPRBIndexDL mod RBGsize) = RBGSize - 1 and inbandPRBIndexDL < numBlankDlPrbsDown + 1;

Hints:
max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 15 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '3 MHz'
- 25 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'
- 50 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz'
- 75 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz'
- 100 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz'

40% of max number of downlink PRBs of the cell depends on the bandwidth and is:
- 6 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '3 MHz'
- 10 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '5 MHz'
- 20 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz'
- 30 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz'
- 40 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz'

where all parameters are O&M parameters, except that RBGsize is:
- 4 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '20 MHz';
- 4 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '15 MHz';
- 3 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to '10 MHz';
- 2 PRBs if dlChBw is equal to or smaller than ' 5 MHz';

relaciones:
(0) Terms & Definitions used in NIDD in context of FDD massive MIMO technology
(0.1) configuration of two FDD LTE cells as Dual-cell, all of following conditions must be fulfilled:
- actMMimo must be 'true' in both cells
- resourceDN parameter value must be the same in both cells
- earfcnDL parameter value must be the same in both cells

(0.2) configuration of two guardband NB-IoT cells as Dual-cell, all of following conditions must be fulfilled:
- Two guardband NB-IoT cells configed as 'dual-cell' if their host cell (refer to 'nbIotLinkedCellId') configed as defined in (0.1).

(1)
(1.1) actMMimo must be set to 'true' if the referenced RF module is 'massive MIMO' capable.
(1.2) actMMimo must be set to 'false' if the referenced RF module is NOT 'massive MIMO' capable.

(2) If actMMimo is set to 'true', all of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
- if actSdlc='false' then 4 LCELL/CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL instances with direction value set to 'RX' must exist
- 4 LCELL/CHANNELGROUP/CHANNEL instances with direction value set to 'TX' must exist
- mMimoHorizontalSectorBFProf must be configured
- actSuperCell must be configured to 'false'
- actMicroDtx must be configured to 'false'
- actCombSuperCell must be configured to 'false'
- dlMimoMode must be configured to ('4-way TXDiv' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x4)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)'
- actCoMp is not allowed to be configured to 'measBaseCoMp'
- nbIoTMode is not allowed to be configured to 'standalone'
- actAutoPucchAlloc must be configured to 'true'
- actDownSampling must be configured to 'false'
- actAntPortMap must be configured to 'false'
- in same LNCEL instance lteNrDssMode must be set to 'none' or actLteNrDss must be set to 'false'
- actMaxNumUeDlNonGbr must be set to 0

(3)
(3.1) if actMMimo is set to 'false', numOfCsiRsAntennaPorts must not be set to '8'. 
(3.2) if actMMimo is set to 'false', dlMimoMode must not be set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)').
(3.3) if actMMimo is set to 'false', actDlMuMimo must be set to 'false'.

(4) Consistency checks for dual-cell configurations:
(4.1) If two FDD massive MIMO LTE cells are configured as dual-cell as per (0.1) then following conditions must be fulfilled:
- dlChBw parameter value must be the same in both those cells
- if dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)') in one cell, then dlMimoMode in the other cell must be set to the same value.
- csiRsResourceConf must be set to different value and csiRsSubfrConf must be set to same value in both cells if dlMimoMode is set to ('Closed Loop MIMO (8x2)' OR 'Closed Loop MIMO (8x4)') in both cells.
- actSdlc parameter value must be the same in both those cells

(4.1.1) In addition to rules (4.1), if both cells have actSdlc set to 'false' then following conditions must be fulfilled:
- prachConfIndex parameter value must be the same in both those cells
- selectPrachRegion parameter value must be the same in both those cells
- blankedPucch parameter value must be the same in both those cells
- if nbIoTMode is set to "guardband" in one of cells then nbIoTMode must be set to either 'guardband' or 'disabled' in the other one.

(4.2) If two guardband NB-IoT cells are configured as dual-cell as per (0.2) then following conditions must be fulfilled:
- guardbandIndexDL parameter value must be the same in both cells.

If actPdcchLoadGen is set to value 'true' all of the following conditions need to be fulfilled:
- pdcchLoadLevel must be configured
- pdcchLoadPsdOffset must be configured
- actEirpControl must be set to 'disabled'.

(1) The value of blankedPucch must be less than nCqiRb and it is considered when calculating MaxPucchResourceSize (the calculation is described under parameter nCqiRb; blankedPucch is part of nCqiRb and therefore implicitly considered in MaxPucchResourceSize ).

(2) For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.

- if ulChBw = '1.4 MHz' or '3 MHz', blankedPucch must be configured to 0
- if ulChBw set to '5 MHz' and actCatM set to 'false', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...16
- if ulChBw set to '10 MHz' and actCatM set to 'false', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...30
- if ulChBw set to '15 MHz' and actCatM set to 'false', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...40
- if ulChBw set to '20 MHz' and actCatM set to 'false', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...60
- if ulChBw set to '5 MHz' and actCatM set to 'true', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...6
- if ulChBw set to '10 MHz', '15 MHz', or '20 MHz' and actCatM set to 'true', blankedPucch must be configured to 0...20

(4)
(4.1) For ulChBw of '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' and '20 MHz':
if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'None' or blankedPucch is less than '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff range is:
roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2) … ulChBw (in PRBs) - 6 - roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2)

(4.2) For ulChBw of '5 MHz', '10 MHz', '15 MHz' and '20 MHz': 
- if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'LowerEdge' and blankedPucch is greater than or equal to '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff ranges are:
   + (0 ... roundup (blankedPucch/2) - 6) and

- if selectOuterPuschRegion is configured to 'UpperEdge' and blankedPucch is greater than or equal to '12', then the allowed prachFreqOff ranges are:

- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumActUE + max(addEmergencySessions, addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)

relaciones:
All of the following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH_FDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.

In case riEnable is set to 'true' AND riPerM is set to '1', cqiPerNp cannot be set to '5ms'.

For each DRX smart profile (x=2,3,4,5,6) the following conditions must be fulfilled:
(1) If drxSmartProfile[x]-drxOnDuratT is less than cqiPerNp
- 12*drxSmartProfile[x]-drxShortCycle must be less than 1000ms.

(2) If drxSmartProfile[x]-drxOnDuratT is greater than or equal to cqiPerNp
- ceil(drxSmartProfile[x]-drxOnDuratT / cqiPerNp)*floor(1000ms / drxSmartProfile[x]-drxShortCycle) must be greater than or equal to 12.

ceil() is the rounded up and floor() the rounded down integer value

(b) for actDrx set to 'true', cqiPerNp must be equal to '20ms'

(3.2) For dlChBw set to '3 MHz' AND dlMimoMode set to 'Closed Loop Mimo' or 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' following condition need to be fulfilled:
(a) for actDrx set to 'false', cqiPerNp must be equal to '20ms'
(b) for actDrx set to 'true', cqiPerNp must be equal to '40ms'

relaciones:
All of the following conditions are applicable in MPUCCH_FDD of the cell only if actAutoPucchAlloc is set to 'false'.

(1.1) If no AirScale deployment  the range for maxNumRrc depends on dlChBw, ulChBw, actFlexBbUsage and actHighRrc according to following conditions:
(1.1.1) if actHighRrc set to 'false' and 
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '1.4 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...40
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '3 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...120
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '5 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...480 
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '10 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...600 
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '15 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...720 (only validated when actCompChecks is 'true')
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '20 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...840
(1.1.2) if actHighRrc set to 'true' and 
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '5 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...840
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '10 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...1000
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '15 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...1250 
- min(ulChBw,dlChBw) is '20 MHz', maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...1500
(1.1.3) if actFlexBbUsage set to 'true' and min(ulChBw,dlChBw) has value '5 MHz' or '10 MHz, maxNumRrc value range is restricted to 0...420 

(2) Following condition needs to be fulfilled with respect to maxNumRrc:
- maxNumRrc >= maxNumActUE

(2.1) if actMultBearers is set to 'false' following conditions need to be fulfilled in addition:
- maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo) >= maxNumActDrb + max(addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)

(2.2) if actMultBearers is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled
- min(6*(maxNumRrc+ max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)), 4500) >= maxNumActDrb + max(addNumDrbRadioReasHo, addNumDrbTimeCriticalHo)
(2.2.1) if additionally actEnhAcAndGbrServices is set to 'false' AND actConvVoice is set to 'true' following condition need to be fulfilled
- maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo) >= maxNumQci1Drb + max(addNumQci1DrbRadioReasHo, addNumQci1DrbTimeCriticalHo)

(3) if actEmerCallRedir is set to 'Enabled' AND if no AirScale deployment following condition needs to be fulfilled:
- maxNumRrcEmergency >= maxNumRrc+max(addAUeRrHo, addAUeTcHo)
 
ALL following conditions (4.x – 6.x) are applicable and checked by the BTS only when actCompChecks is set to 'true'.

(4.1) applicable for deltaPucchShift = 1 AND 
(4.1.1) ... srsActivation is set to 'true'		/*SRS support*/
- maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo,addAUeTcHo) <=  n1PucchAn * cellSrPeriod – 6 * cellSrPeriod/5 * n1PucchAn/36
(4.1.2) ... srsActivation is set to 'false'		/*no SRS support*/
- maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo,addAUeTcHo) <=  n1PucchAn * cellSrPeriod 
(4.2) applicable for deltaPucchShift<>1
- maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo,addAUeTcHo) <=  n1PucchAn * cellSrPeriod 

(5) MIMO mode related checks:
(5.1) applicable for riEnable set to 'false' 				/*no MIMO support*/
- maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo,addAUeTcHo) <=  (nCqiRb - blankedPucch) * 6 * cqiPerNp
(5.2) applicable for riEnable set to 'true' AND riPerM set to '2'  	/*MIMO support*/
- maxNumRrc + max(addAUeRrHo,addAUeTcHo) <=  (nCqiRb - blankedPucch) * 6 * cqiPerNp

(1) The maximum value of nCqiRb depends on ulChBw (in PRB)
- if ulChBw is set to '1.4 MHz', nCqiRb must be configured to 1
- if ulChBw is set to '3 MHz', nCqiRb must be configured to 1
- if ulChBw is set to '5 MHz', nCqiRb is restricted to 1..25
- if ulChBw is set to '10 MHz', nCqiRb is restricted to 1..50
- if ulChBw is set to '15 MHz', nCqiRb is restricted to 1..75
- if ulChBw is set to '20 MHz', nCqiRb is not limited

(2) The value of blankedPucch must be less than nCqiRb.

Pre-condition: actDLCAggr is 'true' in the parent LNBTS of the PCell.
(3.1) nCqiRb is considered in calculation of maxNumRrc in PCell, for details please refer to maxNumRrc
(3.2) nCqiRb is considered in calculation of maxNumRrcEmergency in PCell, for details please refer to maxNumRrcEmergency

(4) The MaxPucchResourceSize in below defines the maximum number of allocated PUCCH RBs, and it can be calculated with following formula and used finally in prachFreqOff:
MaxPucchResourceSize = nCqiRb + roundup{[((rounddown (((maxNrSymPdcch * 12 - X) * dlChBw - roundup (phichRes * (dlChBw / 8)) * 12 - 16) / 36)) + n1PucchAn - pucchNAnCs * 3 / deltaPucchShift ) * deltaPucchShift] / (3*12)} + roundup (pucchNAnCs / 8) - blankedPucch,
where
X=4; when maxNrSymPdcch = 1 or dlMimoMode set to 'SingleTX', 'TXDiv', 'Dynamic Open Loop MIMO' or 'Closed Loop Mimo'
X=8 when maxNrSymPdcch > 1 and dlMimoMode set to '4-way TXDiv' or 'Closed Loop MIMO (4x2)'

(5) If ulChBw is '20 MHz' or '15 MHz': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 24PRB,
If ulChBw is '10 MHz and actFlexBbUsage is 'false': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 24PRB,
If ulChBw is '5 MHz' and actFlexBbUsage is 'false': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 24PRB,
If ulChBw is '10 MHz' and actFlexBbUsage is 'true': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 10PRB,
If ulChBw is '5 MHz' and actFlexBbUsage is 'true': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 10PRB,
if ulChBw is '3 MHz': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 2 PRB,
if ulChBw is '1.4 MHz': MaxPucchResourceSize shall be less than or equal to 2 PRB

For definitions regarding carrier aggregation used in below parameter relationships, please, see the definitions at parameter actDLCAggr.

roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2) … ulChBw (in PRBs) - 6 - roundup ((MaxPucchResourceSize + blankedPucch) / 2)
